messages:
alex: Quick sync — SaffronBank trial: need final owners for integrations, CI timeline, and code-review pings. Can owners call out blockers? Target customer dry-run week Apr 8 and canary Apr 15, final cutover Apr 22. Who's on infra, networking, SE side? :calendar:

jamie: I will own customer comms + success criteria. Quick list: avg latency p95 < 250ms, embedding eval cos sim > 0.78 on their sample set, and VPC peering in staging. I'll upload the eval CSV to the shared drive today.

rita: I can own the backend adapter and schema mapping. ETA: PR for adapter + unit/integration tests by Tue 04/01. Ping me for CRs. Plan: feature-flag `saffron_adapter_v1` for safe rollout.

omar: I'll take networking & staging infra. Need VPN creds + customer CIDR ranges. If expected throughput >100 qps we'll need to provision burst GPU nodes. @rita — once PR merged I can wire up staging deployment.

tara: I'll coordinate dry-run dates with SaffronBank. Prefer week of Apr 8. Also collecting SSO metadata and their compliance questionnaire (I'll circulate).

alex: Blocking checklist right now: 1) adapter PR review (rita) 2) staging security group rules + peering (omar) 3) eval set from jamie 4) telemetry/KMS + threat model (maria). Who's on security review?

maria: maria: I'll own telemetry and KMS key setup. Need final threat model signoff from eng-arch. ETA Wed 04/03 for initial KMS config.

alex: CI status? Any flaky tests we should expect before merge?

ci-bot: ci-bot: build passed for branch `saffron-adapter` (PR #489) — unit & integration suites green. Deploy job to staging will queue once infra label `saffron-staging` exists.

rita: Thanks, ci-bot. I'll hold merge for the schema edge-case test. @omar can you add `saffron-staging` label to infra tracker so deploy moves?

omar: Done — label added and infra ticket created: INF-2214. Linked the ticket to this thread. Will begin provisioning tomorrow morning.

jamie: Customer asked about rollback/rollback criteria. Proposed plan: canary 5% traffic for 1 hour; require errors < 0.5% and p95 < 300ms to promote. If thresholds breach, rollback to previous model and open incident. OK?

alex: Sounds reasonable. @tara make sure customer signs off. Also request: when reviewers approve, add `/approve` in PR so ci-bot can auto-promote.

tara: Customer approved the canary window: Apr 15 10:00-12:00 PST.

rita: I'll tag reviewers in the PR — alex, maria, and ops. Scheduling CRs for tomorrow morning.

alex: I'll review first thing tomorrow. Anything else blocking on your side?

jamie: :thumbsup: I've updated the milestone board with owners and dates: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SAFF-12 (contains checklist and links).

alex: Thanks all. I'll consolidate checklist and send out a one-pager to stakeholders by EOD today.
